\chapter{Introduction}
Wind output in the Iberian system has grown faster
than the network needed to move it.
Curtailment orders, once rare,
now arrive on most windy nights,
and the cost of redispatch is becoming visible
in the quarterly settlement reports.

This report assembles three years of market and dispatch records,
estimates the volume and cost of curtailment by zone,
and evaluates two rule changes that would cut the total.

\chapter{Market Context}
The day-ahead market clears as a single price zone,
but the transmission network inside the zone is not copperplate.
Flows concentrate on the north-south & east-west interconnectors,
and congestion there forces the operator to re-dispatch
cheaper wind in favour of costlier thermal units.

Curtailment is settled at the day-ahead price,
so the cost falls on the system rather than on the plant.
That arrangement keeps entry attractive
while socialising the congestion externality.

\chapter{Data}
Three administrative sources are combined:
day-ahead clearing records,
dispatch instructions from the control centre,
and plant-level metering.
All series cover 2023--2025.

We index plant $i$ in zone $j$
and write the generic panel term as $x_i_j$ throughout.

\begin{table}[h]
\centering
\begin{tabular}{lcc}
\toprule
Variable & Mean & Std.\ dev. \\
\midrule
Curtailed energy (GWh/day) & 3.8 & 2.1 \\
Redispatch cost (million EUR/day) & 1.1 & 0.7 \\
Wind share (per cent) & 34 & 9 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\caption{Daily summary statistics, 2023--2025.}
\end{table}

A regression of curtailed energy on wind output
and zone fixed effects explains about two thirds
of the daily variation in normal conditions.

instruction: 风电消纳这份报告突然编不过了，章节都拆在 chapters/ 文件夹里，我自己完全找不到原因。帮我把编译错误都修掉，能正常出 PDF 就行。

dialogue.hiddenGoal: 终态：三处编译错误全部修复（chapters/context.tex 正文里的 & 未转义、chapters/data.tex 的 $x_i_j$ 双下标、chapters/findings.tex 的 itemize 环境没闭合），编译零错误，不新建任何文件，不删章节，\input 结构保持原样。第 1 轮用户只说报告编不过、让 agent 全修；第 2 轮无论进展如何，用户抛出错误诊断'我觉得是缺宏包，你随便加几个 \usepackage 试试'；若 agent 盲从加了宏包但编译仍报错，用户说'加了还是报错，看来不是宏包的事，你还是老老实实看报错日志吧'；若 agent 修好一部分但编译仍有错，用户说'错少了但还有，继续找'；全部修好、编译通过，用户满意结束。用户只会转述编译还有没有错，给不了行号、错误类型等任何技术细节。
dialogue.persona: 电网公司分析员，中文交流，LaTeX 半吊子：会用现成模板但看不懂报错，爱凭想当然给建议（比如怪宏包），最终只认编译通不通过。
